routes: Existing canonical route set; update registry for behavior changes
apiContracts: Existing API contracts; update method and authorization inventories for behavior changes

dataEntities: Existing canonical D1 entities only; no duplicate ledgers or parallel account-deletion store

migrationPlan.canonicalEntityReuse: Reuse users columns from migrations 0012_user_profiles.sql and 0014_account_preferences.sql; no new schema or parallel account store.
migrationPlan.backwardCompatibility: Preserve existing data and append only to globally sequenced migration history
migrationPlan.rollbackOrForwardRepair: No production migration executed; use migration-specific forward repair for any future applied schema change

uiLifecycle: No browser bundle change in this API-only slice. Account and settings UI synchronization will be delivered in a separate feature integration.

privacySecurity.authentication: All private profile and preference operations require the canonical session.
privacySecurity.authorization: Profile and preference mutations bind the target exclusively to session u.id; public profile projection requires profile_visibility=public and banned=0.
privacySecurity.ownerScoping: Profile and preference reads/writes are scoped by session owner; public projection excludes email, tickets and private account fields.
privacySecurity.csrf: Profile and preference writes reject mismatched Origin and Sec-Fetch-Site=cross-site.
privacySecurity.rateAndSizeLimits: Profile and preference writes use strict allowlists, bounded policy validation and per-account rate limits.
privacySecurity.rightsAndPrivacy: Homepage shelves include published rights-eligible novels only

flags: SSR served after merge and deployment through normal release process
stagingSteps: Verify staging response and client handoff before production

rollback.dataRollbackOrForwardRepair: No D1 production migration executed by this PR

collisionReview.duplicateEntities: Checked against canonical schema and migration collision register
collisionReview.sharedSurfaceOwners: Declared in ownership map and integration contract

changeSummary: Adds owner-scoped account profile and preferences APIs on the canonical users table, a privacy-filtered public profile projection, strict validation, CSRF checks, rate limiting, audit events and exact route/authorization evidence. No migration or production deployment.
